The Masked Ball

At the SI:7 mansion in Stormwind they have a grand masked ball every year. Everyone is in disguise! When a minion dies, its disguise is revealed, showing the minion to actually be a different random minion that costs (2) less and ready for another fight!
This week's Tavern Brawl is The Masked Ball!

A couple of things to note.

  • Whenever you summon a minion, it has an extra deathrattle buff on it to spawn a new minion (a random one of 2 less mana). However, the new minion spawned does NOT have that buff. Keep that in mind when trading for board presence.

  • 1 or 0 mana minions do not spawn a minion when they die. Don't run Voidwalkers or Mana Wyrms.

  • 2 mana minions will spawn 0 cost minions, like Wisp or Target Dummy

  • Minions created by spells (i.e. Animal Companion) do not have this deathrattle buff on them (pretty sure but not 100%. Can someone confirm this?)

  • I believe variable-cost minions (Giants, dread corsair, etc) calculate the minion spawned from the base cost of the minion, not the reduced cost. For instance, I played a Sea Giant for 4 mana and it spawned a Sneed's Old Shredder (8 mana).
Minions spawned from spells do not recieve the buff.
